svg.title: A sound wave of compressions and rarefactions moving out from a string
svg.desc: After many vibrations, the string, shown at several positions as it swings left and right, has sent out a series of compressions (darker bands, solid lines) and rarefactions (paler bands, dashed lines) on both sides. Below, a graph of gauge pressure P_gauge versus distance x from the string is a sine wave: positive at compressions, negative at rarefactions, and only slightly different from atmospheric pressure for ordinary sounds.
